title: Cellpose Masks
description: Apply stock or custom Cellpose weights to microscopy fields, inspect overlays and flows, and save instance masks.
objectives: Connect microscopy TIFF files and select a stock or custom checkpoint.
Review channels, model, thresholds, geometry, denoising, and output categories.
Generate and inspect saved masks, overlays, and Cellpose flows.
prerequisite: Use a model validated for the acquisition and object type; this lesson continues with the calibration checkpoint created in Train Cellpose.

scenes.narration: Cellpose Masks applies a stock CPSAM model or a custom checkpoint to microscopy images and writes one instance-label mask per field. The console records model resolution, normalization, progress, and output paths.
scenes.speech_text: Cellpose Masks applies a stock C P Sam model or a custom checkpoint to microscopy images and writes one instance label mask per field. The console records model resolution, normalization, progress, and output paths.

scenes.narration: The chat field accepts local workflow questions. Enable AI for a configured provider, and use the adjacent arrow to select a provider or open its controls.
scenes.speech_text: The chat field accepts local workflow questions. Enable A I for a configured provider, and use the adjacent arrow to select a provider or open its controls.

scenes.narration: Providers checks the Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini command-line clients and displays their install and login commands while authentication remains with each provider.

scenes.narration: Drop the folder containing TIFF fields. This source contains six real ER-channel cell crops, normalized between percentiles two and ninety-nine point five. Channel zero selects the single plane in each TIFF.
scenes.speech_text: Drop the folder containing Tiff fields. This source contains six real E R channel cell crops, normalized between percentiles two and ninety nine point five. Channel zero selects the single plane in each Tiff.

scenes.narration: Essentials keeps the source, channels, normalization, model, custom checkpoint, diameter, probability and flow thresholds, save switch, batch size, and verbose preview visible.
scenes.speech_text: Essentials keeps the source, channels, normalization, model, custom checkpoint, diameter, probability and flow thresholds, save switch, batch size, and verbose preview visible.

scenes.speech_text: All settings reveals six categories: Input and Channels, Model, Detection Thresholds, Image Geometry, Background and Denoising, and Output and Runtime.

scenes.narration: Recipes saves the complete inference configuration, reapplies it to another image folder, or imports and exports a reusable settings file.
scenes.speech_text: Recipes saves the complete inference configuration, reapplies it to another image folder, or imports and exports a reusable settings file.

scenes.narration: Input and Channels selects the image folder, planes, grayscale handling, inversion, normalization, and percentiles. A wrong channel index can make a valid model appear to detect nothing.
scenes.speech_text: Input and Channels selects the image folder, planes, grayscale handling, inversion, normalization, and percentiles. A wrong channel index can make a valid model appear to detect nothing.

scenes.narration: Model chooses packaged CPSAM weights or a custom checkpoint and supplies the expected object diameter. The custom checkpoint from the preceding tutorial takes priority here.
scenes.speech_text: Model chooses packaged C P Sam weights or a custom checkpoint and supplies the expected object diameter. The custom checkpoint from the preceding tutorial takes priority here.

scenes.narration: Detection Thresholds controls the cell-probability floor, flow agreement, rescaling, resampling, and hole filling. Adjust these only after checking the correct image and model.
scenes.speech_text: Detection Thresholds controls the cell probability floor, flow agreement, rescaling, resampling, and hole filling. Adjust these only after checking the correct image and model.

scenes.narration: Image Geometry optionally resizes fields before inference and restores masks to the original dimensions. Keep the aspect ratio and pixel scale consistent with training.
scenes.speech_text: Image Geometry optionally resizes fields before inference and restores masks to the original dimensions. Keep the aspect ratio and pixel scale consistent with training.

scenes.narration: Background and Denoising applies optional background removal, an intensity floor, and a signal-to-noise screen before segmentation.
scenes.speech_text: Background and Denoising applies optional background removal, an intensity floor, and a signal to noise screen before segmentation.

scenes.narration: Output and Runtime controls mask saving, inference batch size, and verbose figures. Reduce the batch size when model inference exhausts GPU memory.
scenes.speech_text: Output and Runtime controls mask saving, inference batch size, and verbose figures. Reduce the batch size when model inference exhausts G P U memory.

scenes.narration: This run retains a probability threshold of zero, flow threshold zero point four, no rescaling or resampling, and fills interior holes in each accepted object.
scenes.speech_text: This run retains a probability threshold of zero, flow threshold zero point four, no rescaling or resampling, and fills interior holes in each accepted object.

scenes.narration: Run loads the checkpoint, normalizes each batch, predicts masks and flows, fills holes, saves each mask, and displays diagnostics. Stop requests a safe interruption.

scenes.narration: During processing, the console reports the resolved custom checkpoint and batch progress while the figure panel adds original images, red mask overlays, and flow fields.
scenes.speech_text: During processing, the console reports the resolved custom checkpoint and batch progress while the figure panel adds original images, red mask overlays, and flow fields.
